'''2011 German National Championship Marvin Tegeler DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
